_meta.source: specs/formulas.md 'Global defaults' table and section notes; NEPRA Performance Standards (400/230 V, 50 Hz); rho_copper and rho_aluminium from IEC 60364-5-52 Annex G (rho1 = 1.25 x rho20 at working temperature)
_meta.days: days_per_month = 365 ÷ 12 (an average calendar month, two decimals) for every day, month and year conversion, so a year is 12 × days_per_month on every page and matches the 365-day yearly yield (full audit 2026-10-15 WL-106). bill_month_days = the 30-day billing month the bill check (N1) scales a reading cycle to.
_meta.status: Engineering defaults, every one editable on the page. Items marked engineer_confirm need PEC engineer sign-off before launch.

pf_by_load_type_source: Design power factor of an appliance circuit when none is entered (wiring pages, E4): inverter ACs about 0.9 (PFC drive), non-inverter compressors 0.8, resistive heaters (geyser, kettle, iron, heater) 1.0 (pure resistance, same as pf_resistive; Engineer Reviewer 2026-10-15); engineer to confirm
psh_min_source: Lower limit for peak sun hours typed on a page (D6, and D1 when no city is picked): even a dark winter day in Pakistan gives well over 1 kWh/m2 on a tilted panel (Global Solar Atlas monthly PVOUT in data/cities-pk.json), so less is a typing mistake that would size a panel thousands of times too large; audit 2026-10-21 WL-224
margin_max_source: Upper limit for a typed design margin (inverter, generator, controller and solar pages): the usual margin is 1.25 (margin above); three times the load is already an extreme allowance for growth, so a larger number is a typing mistake (12 gave a 30 kVA generator for one AC); audit 2026-10-21 WL-224
load_w_max_source: Upper limit for the load typed on the battery and UPS pages (B1 to B5): 1 MW is far above any home, shop or small business battery bank, so a larger number is a unit mistake (W typed as mW); audit 2026-10-21 WL-224
fuel_per_unit_min_load_pct_source: C8 shows litres and rupees per unit only from this share of the generator's rating up: below it the idle fuel dominates and the per-unit figure runs into thousands of rupees for a few watts (0.0001 W gave Rs 1.59 billion a unit), which reads as an error rather than advice; litres and rupees per hour still show; audit 2026-10-21 WL-224
psh_max_source: Upper limit for peak sun hours typed on a page (D6): a day has at most about 12 kWh/m2 of sun on a tilted panel anywhere (same cap as forecast_max_day_whm2), so a larger value is a typing mistake; full audit 2026-10-15 WL-129
panel_area_m2_by_w_source: Module area (length x width) of common panels sold in Pakistan, from maker datasheets: 330 W 60-cell 1640 x 992 mm, 400 W 108 half-cell 1722 x 1134 mm, 450 W 144 half-cell 2094 x 1038 mm, LONGi Hi-MO 5 550 W 2256 x 1133 mm, LONGi Hi-MO 6 LR5-72HTH 585 W 2278 x 1134 mm. A panel size between two rows takes the area per watt of the row below it (the less efficient class, so the roof is never understated); below the first row, the first row's area per watt (audit 2026-10-21 WL-232); engineer to confirm against the chosen panel's datasheet
panel_volts_source: String voltages of one panel of the default size (panel_w): LONGi Hi-MO 6 LR5-72HTH-585M datasheet (Voc 52.36 V, Vmp 44.21 V at STC, Voc temperature coefficient -0.23 %/C). The Vmp coefficient is not on the datasheet: -0.35 %/C is taken (Pmax coefficient -0.29 %/C plus the usual small rise of Imp with heat), so the hot string voltage is not overstated. Hot cell 70 C (a summer afternoon on a Pakistani roof: about 45 C air plus 25 C in the sun), cold cell 0 C (a winter dawn). Used for the fewest panels in series a hybrid inverter (N7, H1) or a solar pump drive (D15) needs, and the cold string Voc printed on D15 (audit 2026-10-21 WL-172, WL-230); engineer to confirm. Another panel size has other voltages: check its datasheet
hybrid_pv_source: PV input of a 48 V low-voltage hybrid inverter: Growatt SPF 6000 ES Plus user manual (a site source on N2, https://b2b.offgridtec.com/media/product_attachements/Growatt_SPF_6000_ES_Plus_User_Manual_EN.pdf): start-up voltage 150 Vdc, PV array MPPT voltage range 120 to 450 Vdc, max PV open-circuit voltage 500 Vdc. The string's hot Voc must reach the start-up voltage and its hot Vmp the MPPT minimum (audit 2026-10-21 WL-230); engineer to confirm for other models
dc_cutoff_source: Battery voltage at the low-battery cut-off as a share of the bank's nominal voltage, for the DC current a cable and fuse must carry (audit 2026-10-21 WL-177): Growatt SPF 6000 ES Plus user manual low DC cut-off 42.0 V on a 48 V bank at light load (40.8 V and 38.4 V at heavier loads, lead-acid mode; 42.0 V in lithium mode) = 0.875; a 12 V lead-acid UPS cuts off near 10.5 V = 0.875. [ENGINEER] confirm.
max_c_rate_source: Discharge current above which the battery pages warn (C-rate = amps ÷ Ah, audit 2026-10-21 WL-177): lead-acid and tubular batteries are rated at the 10 or 20 hour rate and give clearly less than their Ah above about C/4 (Peukert effect); common 100 Ah LiFePO4 packs have a 100 A BMS (1C continuous). [ENGINEER] confirm.
pump_dc_bus_factor_source: A solar pump drive (VFD) gives the motor its rated voltage only when the DC string reaches about 1.35 x the motor's line voltage (the average DC of a three-phase bridge: 540 V for a 400 V motor, about 300 V for a 220 V motor); the panels in series are counted so the string's hot Vmp reaches it (installer review, audit 2026-10-21 WL-172); engineer to confirm against the drive's recommended MPPT voltage
standard_dc_fuse_a_source: DC battery-to-inverter feeds above the largest MCB: IEC 60269-1 preferred fuse ratings (80 to 250 A, DC-rated gG/gPV or battery fuses); a DC fuse or DC breaker of that rating protects the cable; full audit 2026-10-15 WL-121; engineer to confirm 300 A and 400 A added 2026-10-21 (ANL and MEGA fuse ratings) so a large battery feed reaches the cable check (audit WL-170).
soiling_rate_max_per_day_source: Upper guard for the dust-loss input (5% of output a day, far above the 0.3%/day planning rate and reported dust-storm losses) so a percent typed as a share (0.3 for 0.3%) is rejected; engineer to confirm
ac_life_years_source: ASHRAE Handbook HVAC Applications, Owning and Operating Costs chapter, median service life of residential single or split package air conditioners (15 years); N10 reports no payback when the payback is longer than this (audit WL-22); engineer to confirm
standard_inverter_kw_source: Inverter sizes on sale in Pakistan (on-grid and hybrid lines of Growatt, Inverex, Knox, Solis, Huawei and Fronus; data/component-prices.json lists 4, 5, 6, 8 and 10 kW): the result names the next size at or above the minimum, as C6 does for generators (audit 2026-10-21 WL-174); engineer to confirm
standard_vfd_kw_source: Solar pump drive (VFD) ratings follow the IEC 60072 motor power series (0.75 to 37 kW, the sizes drive makers list); the result names the next size at or above the minimum (audit 2026-10-21 WL-174); engineer to confirm
hybrid_bank_v_source: Battery bank voltage of a grid-tie hybrid inverter on the home decision engine: the export-capable hybrid inverters in data/component-prices.json (Inverex Nitrox 6 kW 48 V, Solis and Solax low-voltage hybrids) run a 48 V bank; LiFePO4 packs are 51.2 V; engineer to confirm
decision_years_source: Comparison period of the Home Power Decision Engine (H1): ten years covers one LiFePO4 battery life and three tubular lives (data/backup-prices.json battery_life_years); editable on the page
dc_ac_ratio_max_source: Typical string/hybrid inverter DC/AC oversize 1.1-1.3 (manufacturer datasheets' maximum recommended PV input, e.g. 130% of rated AC power); engineer to confirm
forecast_max_day_whm2_source: Plane-of-array daily irradiation above about 9 kWh/m2 does not occur at Pakistani latitudes (clear-sky maximum); 12,000 Wh/m2 is a safety cap against bad forecast data; engineer to confirm
